skills.name: koreproject
skills.purpose: Manage project tickets, boards, lanes and ticket relationships.
skills.selection_description: Capture and maintain hierarchical tickets, board placement, ticket dependencies and comments. Read before editing; use returned versions and ticket generation. Agents cannot reset ticket storage.

tools.name: project_read
tools.purpose: Read project context. List records with pagination, or retrieve one record with links, comments and latest 100 revision/activity snapshots. Returns ticket generation for subsequent ticket writes.
tools.returns: Record detail or paginated items, total, offset; generation or explicit ticket_store_error.

tools.name: project_save
tools.purpose: Create or update one record. Common data: title, body, archived. Project: immutable key. Ticket: parent_id, lane_id (null for backlog), priority low/normal/high/urgent, owner, labels, position (nonnegative). Board: title/body; creation adds default lanes. Lane: board_id (immutable), category open/active/done/cancelled, position. Existing records require expected_version. Ticket, board and lane writes require the current generation. Use a unique request_id when creating to make retries safe.

confirm_children.description: Explicitly allow moving a parent with unfinished children into a terminal lane.

tools.returns: Saved record including immutable id/ref and incremented version. Ticket display refs are per-project numbers such as GRID-TKT-101, starting at 1 without leading zeros. Show ref to users; retain UUID id only for API calls and relationships.

tools.name: project_link
tools.purpose: Link tickets with depends_on or relates_to. Rejects cross-project and cyclic dependencies. Ticket links require the current generation. Note can identify evidence URLs or code revisions.

tools.name: project_comment
tools.purpose: Add an attributable investigation note or evidence reference. Ticket, board and lane comments require generation.
